steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Prose literature exams typically test three skills: translation (accurate rendering of the Latin), analysis (identifying language and style features), and evaluation (discussing themes, context, and the author's purpose).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Translation questions require precise, idiomatic English that captures the exact meaning of the Latin. Avoid over-literal or over-free translations.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: For analysis questions, name the stylistic feature, quote the Latin, and explain the effect: 'Caesar uses tricolon (lines 4-5) to build a sense of overwhelming force'.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Evaluation questions (8-10 marks) require a structured argument with introduction, multiple points supported by textual evidence, and a conclusion.

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: What three skills are tested in the prose literature exam? | Q: Why must you quote Latin in your literature answers? | Q: How should you structure a 10-mark evaluation question?

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Translation (accurate rendering of the Latin), analysis (identifying language and style features with their effects), and evaluation (discussing themes, context, and the author's purpose). | Because marks are awarded for supporting points with specific textual evidence. Vague references without Latin quotations score no marks, even if the observation is correct. | Introduction stating your argument, 3-4 detailed points each supported by Latin quotations and analysis, and a brief conclusion. Use connectives to link points and ensure a coherent argument.

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always PEA: Point, Evidence (Latin quote), Analysis (effect). Never make a point without supporting it with Latin. For translation, aim for accuracy first, then idiom. A translation that is wrong but sounds good scores less than one that is accurate but slightly awkward. Prepare a 'toolkit' of stylistic features for each set text author: know their characteristic devices before the exam. In the exam, underline key words in the question and check each paragraph of your answer against them.
